newsitem.title: USA: ABT Building to build Mississippi plant.
newsitem.headline: ABT Building to build Mississippi plant.

text.p: ABT Building Products Corp said Wednesday it plans to construct a new vinyl siding facility in Holly Springs, Miss., about 35 miles southeast of Memphis, Tenn.

The company said it expects to finance the new facility through the issuance of Industrial Development Bonds approved by the Mississippi Department of Economic and Community Development. The operation is expected to be ready for production by the third quarter of 1997.
An existing facility of 240,000 square feet on 33 acres of land will be purchased from the local development authority. ABT said it will add 100,000 square feet.
The total cost of the new plant, including machinery, equipment and fixtures, is estimated at about $16 million, the company said.
The company currently produces vinyl siding at its plant in Acton, Ontario, Canada. The new plant, when completed, will double the company's capacity to produce vinyl siding and accessories.
ABT Building Products Corp produces specialty building products manufactured from engineered wood, plastics and fiber cement.
